retrievalMethod: Direct HTTP snapshots were downloaded for the listed live pages and PDFs. Search-index-only sources and unsuccessful direct retrieval attempts are identified separately and were not represented as downloaded snapshots.

retrievals.supports: Public Sidney Susquehanna River hand launch at 42.315483 N, 75.414102 W and parking for 30 cars.
NYSDEC lists Blackhole at North Jefferson and Bridge Streets as parking and distinguishes it from listed boat launches.
Polaris Bridge Parking Area coordinate/0.3-mile carry to the hand launch; Outer Gooley parking area/0.1-mile carry to the marked take-out.
Jamestown Falls Trailhead Parking Area at 44.3262 N, 74.7226 W and 100-foot carry to the river.
A canoe/kayak launch is in Beach Area on Laurel Hill Lake and is part of a six-mile water trail ending at Kings Covered Bridge.
Official park map/guide identifies the Beach Area launch and publishes park GPS anchors; it does not publish a surveyed wet-edge coordinate.
DNR says the river flows into private property downriver of Big Falls Road; the page does not identify a public launch there.
The survey identifies launches at Route 11 in Bath, Wood Road in Campbell, and Kinsella Park in Erwin, not the stored separate downstream Campbell route endpoint.

retrievals.reviewedVia: NYSDEC search-index result and linked PDF text
retrievals.supports: NYSDEC describes Public Fishing Rights as fishing and bank-walking easements for fishing only; this is not paddling-launch authorization.
The indexed City study names the Moyie Reservoir Boating Takeout and Day-Use Area; it does not provide a current wet-edge coordinate in the reviewed excerpt.
A statewide NYSDEC launch-layer query was retained as contextual evidence; it returned unrelated launch features and was not used to correct any batch 03 coordinate.
Regional Beaver Kill fishing/access context was reviewed as a lead; it does not establish a lawful paddling launch, parking, or carry at Peakville bridge.
American Whitewater defines the route-specific Compactor Pool-to-Black Hole reach and endpoint map pin; it does not establish public parking/boat landing at Black Hole.
County publishes the Warnerville Cobleskill Creek paddling start coordinate and warns its paddling route information is volunteer-shared and not monitored.
SUNY map shows the creek corridor and nearby trail/pavilion context; it does not publish an exact water-entry coordinate or by itself establish current campus permission.

notes: Direct HTTP 404 responses for the Beaver Kill and Moyie PDFs were not treated as source evidence; web search indexed their contents and direct source URLs are retained for future recheck.
All source snapshots are corroboration records, not endorsements of safety or a substitute for current access rules.
The audit cache and generated access registry were not regenerated because shared packages are missing; source edits are verified directly and the stale generated registry is left untouched.
